tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rta phag yid bzhin nor bu las: las byang tshig don dbyer med bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ e ma ho: rta mchog gtsug gi nor bu yi: las byang tshig don dbyer med la: maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sna tshogs bsham: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya: sems can don du sems bskyed bsgom: de nas rang sems ma bcos pa: zhen med lhug pa'i ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das yongs la bka' bsgo bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub ka dag la: lha dang 'dre yi ming yang med: dag dang ma dag rang snang 'di: 'gag med gsal mdangs ngo bo stong: bgegs dang bar chad rang sems yin: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: snang srid thams cad lha ru gsal: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su gsal: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru gsal: 'khor ba myang 'das bdag gzhan med: rang bzhin lhun grub mtshams bcad do: swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: dharma badz+ra rak+ṣa: mchod pa byin brlab ni: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta gu ya sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐ hrī: stong gsal lhun grub dbyings rig 'di: nam mkha' rlung chu sa gzhi me: ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang: pad+ma nyi zla 'ja' 'od klong: ma bsgrubs rang bzhin pho brang shar: e yaṃ khaṃ laṃ raṃ dz+nyā na ho: de dbus rang byung rang shar sku: rnam rtog dregs pa a 'thas gdan: zung 'jug nyi zla'i ga'u'i steng na: shes rig rgyal po rta mchog sku: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: sku mdog dmar po me 'od can: 'khril sbyor bde stong 'od zer 'bar: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum 'gying bag ldan: dbu skra snum 'bol gyen du 'khyil: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu ni: dbu nyug tsam du zhi zhal mdzes: pad zhwa dmar po rtse gnon gsol: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: rang rig snang stong rtsa gsum lha: sprul pa phyogs mtshams me 'od 'khrugs:

rang bab lhun grub chen por gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrī: bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal: rdo rje phag mo pad+ma 'byung: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: snang ba chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: rtsa gsum lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas: rang gsal rang byung gshegs su gsol: bsgoms pa'i lha tshogs mdangs re gsal: ma bsgom lha tshogs lhun gyis grub: dmigs pa mi dgos rang bzhin shar: phyi dang nang med zang thal klong: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gshegs byon bzhugs pa mi mnga' yang: ma rig gzung 'dzin sel phyir du: rang bzhin gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi yum: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma o rgyan rje: rtsa gsum dbyer med lha la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang rig me tog gsal stong dri: rang gsal mar me mnyam nyid chu: bde chen rang grol grags stong sgra: dug gsum bdud rtsi su ra sman: rtsa gsum rang snang lha la 'bul: hūm̐ hrī: dug lnga ye shes rak+ta rdzas: chags sdang mi dmigs gtor ma tshogs: byang sems bde stong mchod pa'i rgyal: dbyings rig dbyer med ka nas dag: rtsa gsum lhun grub lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca: ma hā rak+ta: ma hā ba liṃ ta: te dzo ba liṃ ta: gu ya sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hā: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rta phag pad+ma 'byung: sku ni mi 'gyur gar dgu'i chas kyis brgyan: gsung ni mi 'gag 'ur ldir sing sgra sgrog: thugs ni mtha' bral thig le nyag gcig zlum: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la bstod:

hūm̐ hrī: yon tan rgya mtsho dpag yas gter gyi mdzod: phrin las thogs med mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dul: dpal mgon rta mchog yab yum sras bcas la: a 'thas bstod bya bstod byed ma mchis kyang: rig pa'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du bstod: bshags pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag gzhan thams cad chos nyid la: ma rig zhe sdang srog gcod dang: gnod sems ma byin len pa rnams: rtsa gsum sku yi lha la bshags: sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin la: ma rtogs chags sdang 'chal tshig bsgrags: ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub phra ma rnams: rtsa gsum gsung gi lha la bshags: dran rtog chos nyid 'khor lo la: gti mug dbang gis 'khrul rjes 'brangs: ngan sems log lta ci mchis pa: rtsa gsum thugs kyi lha la bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: yi ge brgya pa bzla: hūm̐ hrī: rang byung skye med rang sgra 'di: rtsa gsum srog gi snying po yin: chu bo'i rgyun nam khong pa'i dbugs: de bzhin nyid du 'di bzlas pas: rang byung klong du rang grol 'gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: 'tsho ba zas skom thams cad bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad par bya'o: hūm̐ hrī: rang rig rang gsal phyi nang bral: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig par bya: rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rnam rtog dngos 'dzin bag chags sbyangs: hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs: ngo bo yig 'bru'i rnam pa la: 'od zer bdud rtsis snang srid khengs: bdud rtsi'i lha tshogs dbyer med bstim: ris med dag pa rab 'byams byon: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs mchod: khams gsum 'khor ba'i nyes byas bshags: bdag 'dzin ru dra mā ra ya phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: tshogs lhag ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag 'dzin phung po'i lhag ma 'di: chos sku skye med ngang du bzhes:

sgo gsum gzung 'dzin lhag ma 'di: thabs shes dbyer med ngang du bzhes: dus gsum dus med lhag ma 'di: sku gsum rol pa'i ngang du bzhes: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas bshal chu 'bul la: badz+ra ḍā ki ma mā: kha khā: la lā: le lā+e: ta tā: te tā+e: i daṃ ba liṃ ta: pañca a mṛta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: kun nas thams cad rang sems lha: nga ni che mchog rtsa gsum yin: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil 'khor lha: dug lnga dug gsum 'dul dus babs: bskul lo 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gang shar 'dzin med gtor ma longs: tshe 'dir chags zhen bral ba dang: bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcad pa yi: phrin las mdzod cig sa ma ya: 'dod chags bde chen ngang du zlog: zhe sdang rang grol ngang du zlog: gti mug chos kyi dbyings su zlog: dngos 'dzin 'od gsal ngang du zlog: bden 'dzin a 'thas ltas ngan zlog: zhen chags che ba'i nad gdon zlog: dam chos bar chad bsod nams zlog: sgrub la bar chad longs spyod zlog: sdig sgrib gsog pa'i mnga' thang zlog: las ngan sgrub pa'i dngos grub zlog: rang rig sgrib pa'i snyan grags zlog: gzung 'dzin rmi lam ngan pa zlog: rtag 'dzin mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: yar gyi bdud sangs rgyas la re ba zlog: mar gyi bdud 'khor ba la ltung dogs zlog: skyid 'dod kyi pho gdon zlog: sdug dogs kyi mo gdon zlog: bzang 'dod kyi yon tan zlog: ngan 'dod kyi dpon ngan zlog: blo bde dang nyams zhen zlog: yid ches dang nges shes zlog: skye med du phya la la zlog: 'gag med du ya la la zlog: gnyis med du khro lo lo zlog: mā ra ya zlog: swa bhā wa zlog: phaṭa phaṭa zlog cig: de nas smon lam dang bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag gzhan dus gsum gsag dang gsag bya yi: rten 'brel dge tshogs ji snyed mchis pa kun: rang rig ka dag lhun grub dkyil 'khor du:

bsngo bya sngo byed ngos bzung bral ba'i ngang: dag pa rab 'byams dbyings su grol bar shog: hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag sgyu ma'i rtsa gsum lha tshogs kun: phyogs ris med pa'i klong du bkra shis shog: ka dag ngo bo 'chi ba med: 'chi med tshe yi bkra shis shog: bde drod rang 'bar na tsha med: bkrag mdangs bcud kyi bkra shis shog: gsal stong 'dzin med bgres rgud med: zag med mchog gi bkra shis shog: ye shes thugs la phyogs ris med: ye sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: de nas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni: ma yengs rang babs kyi spyod lam bskyang bar bya'o: rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang tshig don dbyer med ces bya ba 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du ma rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan yang sprul rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos lha ri snang mtha'i sku rgyab nas bton pa'o// shubhaṃ/// /
